market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $105 Week of August 3 2026?

en.title: WTI $105 Target Fades Amid Low Price
en.summary: The probability of WTI crude oil hitting $105 by August 3, 2026, plummeted by 46.6% to 3% after reports showed September WTI crude at an extremely low $1.08 on July 31, 2026. Despite a minor daily climb due to Strait of Hormuz disruptions, the market perceives $105 as an increasingly remote target.
drivers: WTI crude at $1.08 on July 31, 2026, makes $105 target highly improbable.
Minor +1.29% daily gain insufficient to bridge gap to $105 within a week.
Strait of Hormuz disruptions deemed inadequate to propel WTI to $105.
en.why_matters: This market reflects global oil price expectations, influencing energy investments and inflation outlooks. A sustained low price, even if anomalous, would have significant economic impacts.
en.bull_case: Escalating geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz could trigger severe supply shocks, rapidly pushing WTI prices towards $105.
en.bear_case: The current WTI price of $1.08, despite minor daily gains, makes the $105 target virtually impossible by August 3, 2026.

zh.title: WTI原油105美元目标渐远
zh.summary: 随着9月WTI原油在2026年7月31日报告显示其价格极低至1.08美元，WTI原油在2026年8月3日当周触及105美元的可能性骤降46.6%至3%。尽管因霍尔木兹海峡供应中断而出现小幅日涨幅，市场仍认为从如此低位达到105美元的目标越来越遥远。
drivers: WTI原油7月31日仅1.08美元，使105美元目标极不可能。
日涨1.29%幅度微弱，一周内不足以达到105美元。
霍尔木兹海峡中断影响不足以推动WTI至105美元。
zh.why_matters: 该市场反映全球油价预期，影响能源投资和通胀前景。即使是异常的持续低油价，也将产生重大经济影响。
zh.bull_case: 霍尔木兹海峡地缘政治紧张局势升级，可能引发严重供应冲击，迅速推高WTI油价至105美元。
zh.bear_case: 尽管日内小幅上涨，WTI原油当前1.08美元的价格使2026年8月3日前达到105美元的目标几乎不可能。

Trump's intent for "deal to end war"
Potential for future US administration policy shift
